kept.spine: Stock and people are kept close in, and the ground further out counts as abandoned.
Warmholz bends this far and not much further.
The place works on the terms it has, and what falls short is the terms and not the working.
A place this size ought to have more between its houses and whatever comes than this one has.
More goes on here than anybody looks into, though little of it is hidden.
Nothing in the hamlet is spare, and that is what a careful eye takes in first.
Food is not thought about here, and that is the most that can be said for anybody's food.
The people here are bound to one another the way any settled place is bound, and no further than that.
